messages:
IncidentBot: 🚨 ALERT: p95 latency spike and increased 5xx rate in runtime pool 'wave-4' after today's deploy (rollforward-v3). p95 from 180ms -> 620ms, 5xx up 4.2%. Links: http://ops/alerts/5130001234 · runbook: /runbooks/runtime-latency.md
alex_oncall: I'm on it — paging into channel. Confirming impact and whether rollback is needed.
sally_eng: seeing the same in traces — several hosts flipped to kernel-v2 selector after the rollout. Also batcher logs show microbatch sizes collapsing (batch_size=1) -> high overhead.
lee_mgr: do we have an immediate kill-switch for the rollout flag? If flipping is quick we should cut and stabilize.
maya_ops: prepare to flip rollout flag 'rollforward-v3' off. Command to flip:```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' https://feature-gate.internal/flags/rollforward-v3 -d '{"state":"off"}'
```
alex_oncall: executing now — running the curl, standing by.
alex_oncall: ✅ 200 OK — feature flag off response. Router reported draining variant in 12s.
IncidentBot: FLAG_CHANGE: rollforward-v3 -> off (user: alex_oncall). Traffic shift to previous variant started. p95 dropped to 410ms but still above target. 5xx rate decreased to 2.1%.
dburke: digging into node logs — 4 instances show kernel fallback traces: "kernel_select(): no compatible fast-kernel, falling back to generic-kernel". Batcher metrics show small batches and increased kernel-switch churn. I suspect the kernel selector change plus the batch tuning in the same release caused thrash.
sally_eng: can we force affinity to legacy kernel for wave-4 while we stabilize? I can patch router for that pool. Proposed temporary config: `kernel_affinity: legacy`, `max_batch_ms: 15` for wave-4.
maya_ops: applying affinity patch now for pool wave-4, 2-step: 1) set kernel_affinity=legacy 2) increase max_batch_ms to 15 to allow batching to aggregate. Command:```yaml
PATCH /admin/pools/wave-4
{ "kernel_affinity": "legacy", "max_batch_ms": 15 }
```
maya_ops: patch applied. Confirming rollout.
IncidentBot: CONFIG_CHANGE: pool wave-4 kernel_affinity=legacy, max_batch_ms=15. Observability: p95 -> 260ms within 3m, 5xx -> 0.4%.
jordan_csm: Heads-up — CSM notes 3 paying customers reported request failures (short-term 502/503). I'm sending an incident note and preparing a customer-facing summary. Will loop in sales owners.
lee_mgr: good mitigation. Handoff plan: alex_oncall will stay 20m for warm handoff, then pass to maya_night_ops for overnight watch. dburke to own postmortem (RCA + follow-ups).
alex_oncall: standing by for 20m, will escalate if p95 > 300ms or 5xx > 1% again. Current p95 250ms.
maya_night_ops: ack — I'll take monitoring at T+20m and keep the alert channel open. Please DM me any customer notes.
dburke: postmortem owner assigned. Initial RCA draft: simultaneous kernel selector + batch tuning rollout caused kernel fallback thrash under this traffic shape. Action items: (1) enforce rollout ordering (kernel selector separate), (2) add canary heatmap for kernel-fallback signals, (3) add automated safety gate to disable batch tuning when fallback detected.
lee_mgr: thanks team. When we hit 10m stable p95<300ms and 5xx<0.5% we can close the page. :white_check_mark: 
alex_oncall: closing page in 10m if stable, will update status channel with final numbers. Current: p95=238ms, 5xx=0.2%.
maya_night_ops: logged handoff notes in pager duty, monitoring dashboards up. I'll escalate if we regress.
